notes:
New
- Sweetheart can work through a longer goal by itself. It makes a plan, works through it step by
  step and can hand parts to helper agents. The conversation shows the plan as a checklist, with an
  Agents panel for the helpers.
- Long runs keep going when you close or minimise the window, switch workspace, or quit and reopen
  the app. Switching account or organisation pauses them with a warning, and you can resume them.
- When a run finishes, its result appears in the conversation, the sidebar and Today, and you get a
  notification.
- Changes Sweetheart proposes during a run wait up to 7 days for your review, and are checked again
  when you apply them.
- AI actions for Docs and Files: Check spelling, Summarise and Create Todos, from the right-click
  menu, the Docs toolbar and file rows. Spelling suggestions arrive as comments, a summary can be
  saved as a new Doc, and Todos are shown for review before they are added and linked to their Doc.
- Make your own Docs actions under My actions, with a name and instructions, and run them from the
  same menus.
- Choose the model for each AI action, with fallbacks, in AI actions settings.
- Budgets and usage: see what hosted models cost per call and per run, and set optional per-run and
  monthly limits for each account and organisation. A run that reaches a limit pauses until you
  raise it.
- Run two local chats at once on Gemma 4 E4B. A further local chat waits for its turn.
- Broadcast: choose a post format per destination, such as a Reel or a Post, pick images and videos
  in one picker, and see when a YouTube video counts as a Short.

Improved
- Local models give longer answers and use tools more reliably, and long drafts are saved a section
  at a time.
- Large PDFs and documents are read in parts, and Sweetheart is told which pages it has not read yet.
- Comments written by Sweetheart show its name and where they came from.
- The gpt-oss models are no longer offered as local models.

Fixed
- An image dragged from Finder into a Doc lands under the cursor.
- Changes that were refused are shown as refused.
